# Evaluate named variables over three columns

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The FROG profile stores one row per variable and one column per point. 10*a+b over rows \[1,2,3\] and \[4,5,6\] gives \[14,25,36\].

## What this example demonstrates

The FROG profile stores one row per variable and one column per point. 10*a+b over rows \[1,2,3\] and \[4,5,6\] gives \[14,25,36\].
